content.text: Superficial muscle layer (from common flexor tendon → medial epicondyle)
- flex dist. phalanx of digits 2-5 @ DIP
extends digits 2-5 via MCP, PIP, DIP
extends digit 5 via MCP, PIP, DIP
Base of distal phalanx of thumb (dorsal)
- extend CMC & MCP joints of thumb
Base of proximal phalanx of thumb
- extends prox. thumb phalanx @ MCP joint
